description: HydDown provides Python calculations of pressure-vessel filling and discharge, including heat transfer and the response to external fire. The HydDown contributors maintain it to make gas-storage calculations accessible through short configuration files and reusable code. Users supply a vessel, fluid and operating conditions; the software has no fixed geographic coverage or historical period. Its transient time scale follows the configured calculation. Source code is available from GitHub, and the README documents installation from PyPI and execution with a YAML input file. The MIT licence permits free reuse. Limitations include the documented absence of fluid temperature stratification and potentially slow calculations for mixtures. The current README describes single-component two-phase calculations and an optional one-dimensional vessel-wall conduction model. These features support hydrogen-storage sizing and examination of operational or fire scenarios. Related record model-pandapipes covers pipe networks; HydDown instead resolves an individual storage vessel. That comparison does not imply an implemented interface. Numerical examples and validation claims were read but were not rerun.
inputs: Heat-transfer and discharge or filling conditions in YAML
name: HydDown
notes: G5 G5-0001. Software portability is recorded as global, not worldwide validation. Metadata and documentation checked; software not executed. Independent validation and maintenance commitment not established.
